# Alpha Entrepreneurship Summit 2026 (AES)

> Pakistan's premier youth entrepreneurship summit. A 3-day immersive business summit featuring 5 competitive simulation tracks, angel investor pitches, tactical masterclasses, and executive networking.

- Website: https://alphaace.com.pk
- Dates: November 13 – November 15, 2026
- Venue: Alpha College, Karachi, Pakistan
- Organizer: Alpha College & ACE Society
- Delegate Guide: https://alphaace.com.pk/aes-delegate-guide.pdf
- Registration: https://forms.gle/cGVgw5TpvpU9AXZx5
- Brand Ambassador Program: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=4We7WHOgJUSJuBHvzR0a_yoXsS5ZZMtOmVx09mfgyTNUNkZORUE4VVk5V01XUUxZOExGTVRCMkpDQy4u
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/aes_summit

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://alphaace.com.pk/): Overview of AES 2026, vision pillars, and interactive showcase.
- [Summit Track & Schedule](https://alphaace.com.pk/schedule): Chronological itinerary across Day 01 (Nov 13), Day 02 (Nov 14), and Day 03 (Nov 15).
- [Summit Modules](https://alphaace.com.pk/modules): Deep dive into the 5 competitive simulation tracks.
- [Executive Council](https://alphaace.com.pk/executives): Leadership board, director bios, and LinkedIn profiles.
- [Ambassador Program](https://alphaace.com.pk/ambassadors): Multi-tier rewards, team discounts, and campus ambassador roles.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://alphaace.com.pk/faq): Delegate eligibility, lodging, fees, and event conduct.

## The 5 Flagship Modules

1. **Investomania** (3 Rounds): High-frequency financial trading simulation, portfolio risk management, macroeconomic shocks, and options valuation.
2. **Defend The Empire** (3 Rounds): Corporate crisis management, hostile takeover defense, public relations mitigation, and regulatory hearings.
3. **Market Monopoly** (2 Rounds): Karachi-inspired property bidding, cash flow strategy, cross-team mergers, and bank debt financing.
4. **Venture Verse** (2 Rounds): Original startup pitch to angel investor judges, business model viability defense, and unannounced crisis resolution.
5. **Viral Velocity** (3 Rounds): Guerrilla marketing challenge, Instagram brand identity growth, paid media budgeting, and real-world consumer prototype stall.
